opportunities.title: Main Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Projects led by organisations or institutions based in the UK (exceptions for overseas organisations in exceptional cases). Applicants must have formal employment or contractual relationship with the host institution for the project duration.
opportunities.summary: Offers up to £500,000 for research addressing priority questions from the Strategic Review, with two annual deadlines (Spring and Autumn). Most grants are below £300,000; special cases up to £750,000.

opportunities.title: Racial Diversity UK Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Encourages applicants from diverse backgrounds, particularly from racially minoritised communities, and welcomes partnership applications involving researchers and communities.
opportunities.summary: Supports research on racial diversity within the UK, focusing on inter‑generational changes and challenges. Grants range from £15,000 to £500,000, with a single annual deadline in Autumn.
